content:wysiwyg_basic:2:72.html:
Summer Camp

The Salvation Army Hampton Roads Area Command provides both local and away camp opportunities.

Local Day Camps

Kroc Hampton Roads – June 8, 2026, through August 14, 2026

Serving children in Norfolk, Virginia Beach, Chesapeake, and Portsmouth

Click Here for More Information

Camp Rappahannock

Located in the scenic heart of Virginia, Camp Rappahannock is a vibrant summer destination where adventure, community, and faith come alive. For generations, campers have discovered unforgettable experiences here—experiences that ignite confidence, inspire growth, and draw young people closer to God. At Camp Rappahannock, kids step away from screens and step into creation, exploring the outdoors in ways that spark wonder and deepen their sense of purpose.

Whether campers are hiking wooded trails, paddling the river, scaling the climbing wall, or sharpening their aim at the archery range, children are surrounded by opportunities to try new things and thrive. Our dedicated staff create a safe, joyful, and Christ-centered environment where every camper is known, valued, and encouraged. Camp Rappahannock is more than a place to spend the summer—it is a place where friendships form, faith grows, and memories last a lifetime.

For more information and to register your child for Camp Rappahannock, please click below.

Click Here for More Information

For questions or registration assistance, please contact:

Families in Norfolk, Virginia Beach, or Chesapeake (Excluding zip codes 23321 and 23323)

  • Stacey Adkins | (757) 335-2361 | stacey.adkins@uss.salvationarmy.org

Families in Portsmouth and Chesapeake Zip Codes 23321 and 23323 only

  • Major Ronnette Smith | (304) 546-0931 | ronnette.smith@uss.salvationarmy.org

Families in Suffolk and Western Tidewater

  • Captain Karen Twinney | (832) 771-0649 | karen.twinney@uss.salvationarmy.org

Looking to Change a Child’s Life This Summer?

If you are interested in sponsoring a child for summer camp, please contact Beth Hornby, Development Director at (757) 271-8431 or beth.hornby@uss.salvationarmy.org.

Accreditation

Our camps are accredited through the American Camping Association (aca).
